about: Loyalist Township is a rural municipality in Lennox and Addington County, Ontario, west of Kingston toward Bath, Amherstview, and the Lake Ontario shore. Villages, Loyalist Parkway scenery, and countryside share the township rather than forming a single city. About 18,000 people live in Loyalist Township.
seoSummary: Lennox and Addington township of Amherstview and Bath—Lake Ontario villages on the Loyalist Parkway, not a city.
